scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run client" "npm run server"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.lint: cd client && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
